headline: All Hail King Jesus: Preseason Front Office Brief
executive_summary: All Hail King Jesus is projected #7 of 16 with a 620.90 projected-starting-lineup C-AVI total, led by Jaxon Smith-Njigba, Amon-Ra St. Brown, and Tee Higgins. The immediate priority is improving the RB slot without weakening that core.

latest_trade.summary: On July 13, All Hail King Jesus traded with Ravens Regime and acquired Isiah Pacheco, 2026 Round 1 (Southside Savages) while sending Derrick Henry. Isiah Pacheco is now on the current roster at 46.0 C-AVI and 58.6 D-AVI; The deal added 1 draft asset.
